newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering turnover rose in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering turnover rose in Q1 1997.

text.p: Total turnover of Britain's engineering industries in the first quarter of 1997 rose by 0.2 percent compared with the previous three months, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) said on Monday.
This was a result of a fall in home turnover of 1.3 percent more than offset by a 2.3 percent increase in export turnover.
Compared to the same period a year ago total turnover increased by 0.4 percent.
Total orders on hand at the end of March 1997 were 1.3 percent down on the level at the end of December 1996 and 6.5 percent down on March 1996.
